When the cabinet's maze flashes after you clear it, it's now just recoloured with the existing flash colour from PR 15, so it no longer needs a separate texture.

To test on the phone: play the maze level, then clear it to reach the cabinet. Check that the zoom-out doesn't jump and the joystick still works.

turns.prompt:
did we put screenshots for the earlier PRs into the making of (where it makes sense)?
if not should backfill, and make sure we do it going forward
turns.reply:
Mostly yes, but two jam turns that changed something you can see had no screenshot. I've backfilled both and changed the setup so screenshots are taken every time from now on. Pull request: https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/21

**Backfilled.** I took each shot from a copy of the game at that turn's own commit, so it shows how things looked then:
- The menu footer change (Making-Of · Lab · Impressum in one row).
- The making-of credits note (Max and Quirin, Gasteig HP8, Gamerei).

The other jam turns either already have screenshots or only changed design docs, tooling or answered a question, so there was nothing to show.

**Going forward:**
- **One command:** a new script, `tools/shot.js`, takes a phone-size screenshot of any page or game scene and saves it straight into the making-of media folder. It can also shoot an older commit.
- **Late screenshots now show up:** the exporter used to attach screenshots only to sessions run in the current container. So a screenshot added later for an older session never appeared on the page. It now attaches them for every session.
- **Rule in `CLAUDE.md`:** every turn that changes something visible (game, lab, making-of, event or Impressum page) saves one or two screenshots. Turns that only touch docs, tooling or the log are exempt.

To test on the phone after merging: open `/making-of/` and check that both the menu footer turn and the credits turn now show a screenshot.

Plan usage: 3% of the 5-hour limit, 18% of the weekly limit.
